tagShapeMismatches.english: Nestled among the bookshelves are five incense sticks (worth 10 gp each) and a {@item component pouch|PHB}. A character who inspects the area and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check also finds a hidden compartment in one of the shelved books. Inside is a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Protection from Evil and Good}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 書架間有五支薰香（每支價值10gp）和一個{@item 材料包|PHB}。一名仔細檢查併成功透過{@dc 15}的智力（{@skill 調查}）檢定的角色還能在其中一本書後發現一個暗格，裡面有一張{@spell 防護善惡}的{@item 法術卷軸}。

numericDifferences.english: {@i Vecna: Nest of the Eldritch Eye} is a fifth edition Dungeons & Dragons adventure for four to six characters of level 3. This adventure takes place in the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast. A sinister cult has crept into the city's bowels, and the characters must infiltrate the cult's hideout and root out its members before harm befalls the city.
numericDifferences.localized: 《{@i 維克那：妖眼魔窟}》是一篇龍與地下城第五版冒險，適用於4-6名3級角色。這場冒險發生在劍灣的無冬城。一支罪惡的邪教已經悄無聲息地刺入了城市的內臟，而角色們必須滲透進邪教的藏身處，在他們危害城市安全之前將其連根拔起。

numericDifferences.english: This adventure is designed to be playable in two or three hours. The characters are contracted by Lord Protector Dagult Neverember of Neverwinter to patrol the city. When a dead man is found clutching a withered eyeball, the characters are tasked with uncovering the cause of the man's death. This leads the characters to investigate the city's old catacombs and confront cultists of the lich-god Vecna.
numericDifferences.localized: 這篇冒險設計遊玩時間為2-3小時。角色們和無冬城的護國公達格魯特·無燼簽訂了合同，保衛這座城市。角色們會發現一個死去的男人，手中緊緊攥著一顆乾癟的眼球，而他們的任務就是揭開這個男人死亡的原因。由此，角色們將會被引去調查這座城市眾多古老的地下墓穴，並直面巫妖之神維克那的邪教徒。

numericDifferences.english: The city of Neverwinter stands proudly on the Sword Coast, west and north of Dessarin Valley. Fifty years ago, the city was nearly destroyed by the eruption of Mount Hotenow. Today, the city stands mostly rebuilt. It bustles with skilled tradespeople, intrepid adventurers, and hardy townsfolk.
numericDifferences.localized: 無冬城在劍灣德沙林河谷的西北方傲然挺立著。50年前，這座城市由於霍特諾火山的噴發而瀕臨毀滅。如今，這座城市已經幾近重建完成。老練的工匠，無畏的冒險者與堅忍不拔的平民在城中絡繹不絕。

numericDifferences.english: A foul stench rises from the murky sewage that fills most of this large chamber. Three four-foot-tall burbling masses slink through the muck.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個房間的地面上覆蓋著一層渾濁的汙水，散發著一股惡臭的氣味。三隻有約4尺高的巨物身著淤泥，蠕動著，冒著泡。
